_doc: Portal list for tools/ats_scan.mjs — free zero-token ATS discovery. greenhouse/ashby use `api` or `careers_url`; workday/smartrecruiters use `careers_url` (provider derives the endpoint). Verify: node tools/ats_scan.mjs tools/portals.json (right token → jobs; wrong → 404/422 or WRONG COMPANY — always eyeball the first title). Providers: greenhouse, ashby, lever, workday, smartrecruiters, workable, recruitee, bamboohr, teamtailor, breezy, personio, rippling, successfactors, avature, jibeapply (+ job boards; see ../career-ops/providers/). NO iCIMS/Taleo/Oracle/Eightfold provider — those companies stay on Apify. Workday tenants self-bound via ctx.sinceMs early-stop (since_days). All tokens below VERIFIED live 2026-07-03.
_setup_note: EXAMPLE FILE. /setup writes tools/portals.json with your own anchor companies' boards. The entries below exist to show the shape of each provider type — they are not recommendations. Find a company's board by opening its careers page and reading the URL: boards.greenhouse.io/<token>, jobs.ashbyhq.com/<token>, <company>.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/<site>, jobs.smartrecruiters.com/<token>, jobs.lever.co/<token>.
_gotcha: Verify the token, don't guess it. Short company names often collide with an unrelated business on the same ATS, and you will silently scrape the wrong board. Check with: node tools/ats_scan.mjs --verify
_location_note: Geographic scope for board results; set your own in config/search_profile.json. Empty locations pass (missing data isn't a reason to drop a row); always_allow beats block; block trims offshore-hub noise from multinationals' global boards. This trims, it is not a hard gate — the logistics score still applies.
